title: Hermes Second Brain data ownership and routing boundaries

routing_boundaries.durable_fact: A stable user fact or preference is curated into USER.md; it is never made durable merely because it appeared in temporary context or intake staging.
routing_boundaries.temporary_context: Short-lived situational context belongs only in the Context Inbox TTL table with an explicit UTC expiry and is never mirrored into durable memory or OpenViking.
routing_boundaries.routine: A recurring user routine belongs to the single Hermes-native recurring reminder and routine workflow; Context Inbox habit hypotheses are derived signals staged for review, never an alternative routine master, and routines are never written to USER.md, MEMORY.md, or the TTL table.
routing_boundaries.episode: A time-bounded episode may use the Context Inbox TTL table when it has an explicit expiry; raw transcript history remains owned by the canonical Hermes session-state store, and LCM summaries are derived rather than a second master.
routing_boundaries.self_lesson: An assistant operational lesson or environment fact is deliberately curated into MEMORY.md, never inferred from an unapproved staged plan.
